# Isaiah Chapter 29 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 24 verses]*

*Ariel (Jerusalem) besieged; sealed vision; lip-service religion; wisdom confounded; future reversal*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** These people draw near with their mouth and honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me. This chapter ariel (jerusalem) besieged.

*-- LOGOS*
